title: Counter Card: Entry Conditions for a Trade-In Registration by Programme
content:
A piece is registered under one of the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes only where it clears that programme's published entry conditions on where it came from, what it sold for, what it is worth, how long the customer has owned it and how soon after purchase it is brought in. The card below carries the figures for each programme; the counter reads them against the registration's own details.

## Conditions on the piece and its purchase

| Programme | Smallest original selling price (USD) | Smallest appraised value (USD) | Must have been sold by the chain | Registration deadline after the original purchase (calendar days) | Least time owned before trade (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 199 | 99 | no | 30 | 0 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 999 | 499 | yes | none (0) | 180 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 1999 | 999 | yes | none (0) | 180 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 2999 | 1499 | yes | none (0) | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 9999 | 4999 | yes | none (0) | 365 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | none (0) | 2499 | no | none (0) | 0 |

A registration deadline of 0 means no deadline applies under that programme; a holding period of 0 means the piece may be traded on the day it was bought.

## Conditions on the customer

| Programme | Proof of ownership before the piece is taken in | Identity verified before credit is issued |
|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | yes | yes |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | yes |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | yes |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | yes |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes | yes |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | yes |

Both conditions hold under every programme without exception.

## The gate into each programme

Each programme also opens only to a piece that answers to its gate:

- Belrose Standard Trade-In: an appraised value of at least 99 USD and proof of ownership.
- Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee: an original selling price of at least 999 USD, bought from Belrose, with a laboratory certificate.
- Bridal Upgrade Guarantee: an original selling price of at least 1999 USD, bought from Belrose, as a bridal purchase.
- Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee: an original selling price of at least 2999 USD, bought from Belrose, with the annual inspections current.
- Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege: an original selling price of at least 9999 USD, a Signature Collection piece, in excellent condition.
- Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme: an appraised value of at least 2499 USD, an estate intake appointment, and proof of ownership.

## Reading the card

- A piece that originally sold for exactly 999 USD reaches the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee's smallest original selling price; one that sold for 998.99 USD does not.
- The Belrose Standard Trade-In is the only programme with a registration deadline: a piece bought 30 calendar days ago may still be registered under it, and one bought 31 calendar days ago may not.
